questions.stem: Shape $A$ is enlarged to give shape $B$. A side of $A$ is $5\text{ cm}$ and the corresponding side of $B$ is $15\text{ cm}$. If the area of $A$ is $20\text{ cm}^2$, what is the area of $B$?
questions.explanation: The scale factor is $\frac{15}{5} = 3$. Area scales by $k^2 = 3^2 = 9$. So the area of $B$ is $20 \times 9 = 180\text{ cm}^2$.
